gate.EI: 21 ETFs: median delta CAGR >= 0, share > 0 >= 60%, share delta DD <= 3.0 pp >= 80%, pooled bootstrap median >= 0 (500 paths/instrument)
gate.G1: m = 2 return: CAGR >= K's, or Calmar >= 1.1 x K's with CAGR >= K -0.5 pp (base and calibrated)
gate.G2: max DD <= K + 1.0 pp (base and calibrated, m = 2)
gate.G4: CAGR above K in >= 2 of the 3 sub-periods
gate.G5: block-20 bootstrap median (base and calibrated) >= 0.0 pp
gate.G7: six OOS windows: median >= 0.0 pp; >= 5/6 with delta CAGR >= -0.5 pp and delta DD <= 3.0 pp; delta DD never above 8.0 pp
gate.PL: plateau: every Q arm has base-m2 delta CAGR > 0.0 pp and delta max DD <= 1.0 pp
gate.T1: after tax at $100k: arm - K >= 0.0 pp in all three windows
gate.T2: B1-recent bootstrap median >= 0.0 pp and share > 0 >= 55%
gate.T3: B2 flat-20% bootstrap median >= 0.0 pp and share > 0 >= 55%
gate.adopt: a candidate is adopted only if every gate passes; ties by mean after-tax $100k delta, then B1 median; else production keeps K

gates.reason: no candidate clears every gate: Q1 fails G2,G7,EI,PL; Q2 fails G1,G4,G6,G7,T1,T2,T3,PL; Q3 fails G2,G7,EI,PL -> production keeps K

reference.pre_tax: band_h2_combo_v1/RESULTS.json pre_tax_main[K]: 15.7649 / 15.1785 % CAGR, max DD 46.6698 / 46.7948 %, turnover 5.4561

params.composition: K = A1u + H2. On a pending discretionary downward resize the H2 December window is tested FIRST: if the fill session is one of the last DEC_TAIL December sessions and 0 < target < held weight, the resize is postponed; otherwise A1u's gain-scaled band decides. Exits to zero and up-resizes always fill. A suppressed or postponed resize is never re-tried: the target is re-evaluated at every close.
params.early_leg: all arms keep production K's execution layer; the candidates change only the early re-entry leg's entry/exit condition
